title: General discussion on RFC-0035 (FIPS) and RFC-0036 (Phase 4 pilot)
author: pete-gov
body:
Hey all - as a reminder, FedRAMP can't answer questions or generally participate directly in RFC threads to avoid influencing public comment. Sometimes this creates confusion because folks just want to talk about details of something proposed in an RFC to understand it better or learn more about it, so we create these side-threads at times for RFCs.

The two open RFCs in question are:

- #179 
- #180 

Please feel free to use this thread to discuss, ask questions, etc. - but don't forget to add public comment with feedback either way!

comments.author: StevenCh99
comments.body:
With regards to: FRC-CLD-CTP:
"Providers seeking a FedRAMP 20x Class D Certification SHOULD limit the likely handling of federal customer data within the cloud service offering to third-party information resources that are included in a FedRAMP Class B, Class C, Class D, or Class G Certified offering."

What is a Class G Certified offering? I do not believe I have seen or heard references to that previously.

Thank you!
